Question ( Mandatory ): Who owns the personal follow-up after a Day 7, Day 8 or Day 9 member reply?
Option A ( Optional ): Any trainer working the next shift
Option B ( Optional ): The Retention Manager or approved management cover

Question ( Mandatory ): Who owns the written response and review-workflow state?
Option B ( Optional ): The trainer who sees the member first

Question ( Mandatory ): What should you do after reading a positive reply?
Option B ( Optional ): Call promptly, thank her, build rapport, check her review status and make a natural referral invitation
Option C ( Optional ): Ask for a friend's contact details before checking consent
Option D ( Optional ): Complete the task without contacting the member

Question ( Mandatory ): What is the main purpose of a positive follow-up?
Option C ( Optional ): Make the member feel noticed, build rapport and create a consent-based referral opportunity

Question ( Mandatory ): What should you do if a negative reply involves a complaint or cancellation intention?
Option B ( Optional ): Call promptly, understand the concern, record it in an internal GHL note and escalate findings that need owner intervention
Option D ( Optional ): Remove the member from every workflow

Question ( Mandatory ): What should you do if the task still asks you to classify the reply or correct the review workflow?
Option B ( Optional ): Complete the task and leave no note
Option C ( Optional ): Leave it open and ask Admin Eve or management for a clear handoff
Option D ( Optional ): Reassign it to a general trainer

Question ( Mandatory ): What must be recorded before the task is completed?
Option B ( Optional ): The contact details, what the member shared, review or support outcome, consent-based referral details, owned next actions and any escalation in an internal GHL note
Option C ( Optional ): Only whether the member was positive or negative
Option D ( Optional ): Nothing if the follow-up happened in person

Question ( Mandatory ): What should happen if the assigned Retention Manager is away?
Option B ( Optional ): It is assigned to any available trainer
Option C ( Optional ): Management assigns it to approved cover
